text:
incident-bot: P1 pager triggered — elevated 5xx rate on gen-api-usw (request path: /v1/generate). Pager routed to @Alice and ops-oncall.
Alice: Acked, investigating. Seeing spike starting ~02:03 UTC, CPU on some GPU nodes spiked, a handful of 502/503 traces.
Bob: Thanks Alice. Can you confirm if this is a routing/backing infra issue or model runtime? Any quick mitigation (kill/restart instance) possible?
Alice: Initial grep shows a small subset of proxies returning `upstream timed out` to runtime pool; not all nodes. I can try cycling the affected proxy group.
Carol: Heads-up — we should draft an initial status page update asap. Probable audience: SRE, platform customers in US-west. I can draft copy if you confirm impact and mitigation plan.
Alice: Mitigation: cycling proxy group A is helping. RTs dropping. Will monitor 5m after restart.
Bob: If proxy restarts reduce errors, we should include rollback fallback (route to standby pool). Also need legal/marketing check for customer-facing wording.
Dan: Quick legal check — standard wording ok, avoid implying data loss. Keep it factual: "service interruptions" or "elevated error rates" fine.
Carol: Draft (proposed initial) —
```
We are investigating elevated error rates for text generation requests served from our US-West region. Some requests are seeing 5xx responses; users may experience failed generations or increased latency.
- Time detected: 02:03 UTC
- Impact: subset of requests routed to US-West may fail or timeout
- Mitigation in progress: operations are cycling a proxy group and routing traffic to standby pool
We will post updates as we have more info.
```
Carol: Proposed publish cadence: initial now, update in 10m with impact assessment, then hourly until stable. Any objections?
Erin: Add note about affected API paths (/v1/generate) and advise customers to retry. Also include link to incident page once created.
Bob: Suggest adding estimated time window for users: "intermittent failures since 02:03 UTC" rather than promising a fix ETA.
Alice: Confirming proxy restart reduced errors ~75% for affected nodes. Still tracking a few flapping connections. Will reroute any nodes that re-flap.
Carol: Updated draft with Erin/Bob notes —
```
We are investigating elevated error rates for text generation requests (POST /v1/generate) in the US-West region. Some requests may fail with 5xx errors or experience increased latency. Intermittent failures observed since 02:03 UTC.
Mitigation: Operations are cycling an affected proxy group and routing traffic to the standby pool. We advise customers to retry requests; we are not aware of data loss.
We will provide another update in ~10 minutes.
```
Bob: :thumbsup: Looks good. Dan, good from legal?
Dan: Good to publish.
Carol: I'll publish initial update to statuspage in 2 minutes unless someone calls hold.
Alice: No hold from oncall — go ahead. I'll keep monitoring and post any major changes here.
incident-bot: Statuspage initial update published (update_id: upd_8a7c). Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-451234
Carol: Posted. Will post follow-up in 10m with current error rates and customer impact summary.
Erin: Quick ask — please add note to internal incident doc with the query used for error rate so we can reproduce. I'll paste it in the doc.
Bob: Thanks team. If we see re-escalation, plan is: 1) fail traffic to standby, 2) hotfix config if needed, 3) rollback last routing change.
Alice: Monitoring shows sustained reduction; error rate at ~2% now vs 12% peak. Holding for 15m.
Carol: Next update queued for 02:18 UTC. Preparing customer-facing wording for that update.
incident-bot: Status update posted (upd_8a7c-followup) — 02:18 UTC: errors reduced, mitigation continuing.
Alice: Marking to resolve if stable for next 30m. Will confirm final resolve copy.
Carol: Draft resolve notice —
```
Resolved: We have restored normal operation for text generation in US-West. The elevated error rates observed starting 02:03 UTC were mitigated by cycling an affected proxy group and routing traffic to the standby pool. Error rates returned to baseline by ~02:45 UTC. No data loss has been detected. If you continue to see issues, please contact support with request IDs.
```
Dan: Resolve copy OK.
Bob: :thumbsup:
Alice: Confirmed stable. Please publish resolve when ready.
Carol: Published resolved update to statuspage (resolve_id: res_1b2c). Closing internal comms thread in 30m for post-incident notes.
incident-bot: Incident marked resolved by Alice at 02:46 UTC. Incident page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-451234/resolved
Carol: I'll follow up with a short internal postmortem draft and the customer notification template in #incidents-postmortems.
Alice: Thanks all. Will include timeline and logs in the incident doc for SRE review.
